recipes.title: Banana Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/4 cups flour
2 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp salt
1 cup milk
1 egg
2 tbsp melted butter
1 ripe banana, mashed
Butter or oil for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt in a large bowl.
In another bowl, whisk milk, egg, melted butter, and mashed banana.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir just until combined.
Heat a lightly greased skillet over medium heat.
Pour 1/4 cup batter per pancake; flip once bubbles form, about 2 minutes per side.
Serve warm with syrup or extra banana slices.

recipes.title: Fluffy Buttermilk Waffles
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
2 tbsp sugar
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1 1/4 cups buttermilk
2 eggs, separated
5 tbsp melted butter
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt together.
Whisk buttermilk, egg yolks, melted butter, and vanilla in another bowl.
Beat egg whites to soft peaks.
Combine wet and dry ingredients, then fold in egg whites.
Cook in a preheated waffle iron until golden and crisp.
Serve with butter and maple syrup.

recipes.title: Classic Scrambled Eggs with Chives
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
3 tbsp milk
Salt and pepper to taste
1 tbsp butter
2 tbsp chopped chives
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper until smooth.
Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over low-medium heat.
Pour in eggs and stir gently and continuously as they set.
Remove from heat while still slightly glossy.
Stir in chives and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Veggie and Cheese Omelet
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/4 cup milk
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp butter
1/2 cup diced zucchini
1/2 small onion, diced
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, and pepper.
Saute zucchini and onion in butter until softened, about 5 minutes.
Pour eggs over vegetables and cook over medium-low heat, lifting edges as they set.
Sprinkle cheese over half the omelet.
Fold in half once mostly set and cook 1 more minute.
Slice into portions and serve.

recipes.title: Overnight Oats with Berries
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups rolled oats
1 1/2 cups milk
3/4 cup plain yogurt
2 tbsp honey
1 1/2 cups mixed berries
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Divide oats among three jars or containers.
Stir together milk, yogurt, honey, and vanilla, then pour over oats.
Top each with berries and stir gently.
Cover and refrigerate overnight.
Stir before serving, adding a splash of milk if too thick.

recipes.title: Cinnamon Raisin French Toast
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices cinnamon raisin bread
3 eggs
2/3 cup milk
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tbsp butter for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs, milk, cinnamon, and vanilla in a shallow dish.
Dip each bread slice, coating both sides.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook slices 3 minutes per side until golden and cooked through.
Serve with syrup or a dusting of powdered sugar.

recipes.title: Breakfast Burritos with Potatoes and Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups diced potatoes
1 tbsp oil
6 eggs, beaten
1/2 cup shredded cheese
3 large flour tortillas
Salt and pepper
Hot sauce, optional
recipes.instructions:
Saute potatoes in oil over medium heat until browned and tender, about 12 minutes, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Push potatoes aside, add eggs to the pan, and scramble until just set.
Mix eggs and potatoes together with cheese.
Warm tortillas, fill with the mixture, and roll into burritos.
Serve with hot sauce if desired.

recipes.title: Greek Yogurt Parfait
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/4 cups plain Greek yogurt
3/4 cup granola
1 1/2 cups sliced strawberries
3 tbsp honey
recipes.instructions:
Layer yogurt, granola, and strawberries in three glasses.
Repeat layers until glasses are full.
Drizzle honey over the top of each parfait.
Serve right away for the best crunch.

recipes.title: Whole Wheat Blueberry Muffins
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups whole wheat flour
1/2 cup sugar
2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup milk
1/3 cup oil
1 egg
1 1/2 cups blueberries
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk milk, oil, and egg in another bowl, then combine with dry ingredients.
Fold in blueberries gently.
Divide batter among cups and bake 18-20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool in the tin 5 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Savory Breakfast Hash
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups diced potatoes
1 tbsp oil
1/2 onion, diced
1 zucchini, diced
1 cup cooked diced ham
Salt and pepper
3 eggs, fried, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add potatoes and cook, stirring occasionally, until browned, about 15 minutes.
Add onion and zucchini and cook 5 more minutes until tender.
Stir in ham and cook until heated through, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Top each portion with a fried egg to serve.

recipes.title: Baked Oatmeal with Apples
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups rolled oats
1 tsp baking powder
1 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp salt
1 3/4 cups milk
1 egg
1/3 cup brown sugar
2 tbsp melted butter
1 apple, diced
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F and grease a baking dish.
Mix oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Whisk milk, egg, brown sugar, and melted butter, then stir into the oats along with the apple.
Pour into the baking dish.
Bake 30-35 minutes until set and golden on top.
Cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast Quesadillas
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs, scrambled
1 cup shredded cheddar
6 small flour tortillas
1/2 cup diced cooked sausage
2 tbsp butter
Salsa for serving
recipes.instructions:
Scramble the eggs with the sausage until just set.
Lay three tortillas flat and top each with eggs and cheese, then close with the remaining tortillas.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook each quesadilla 2-3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Pancakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cottage cheese
4 eggs
1/2 cup flour
1 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
Butter for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Blend cottage cheese and eggs until fairly smooth.
Whisk in flour, sugar, and vanilla until just combined.
Heat a lightly buttered skillet over medium-low heat.
Spoon batter into small rounds and cook 2-3 minutes per side until golden.
Serve with fruit or syrup.

recipes.title: Shakshuka-Style Baked Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp oregano
Salt and pepper
5 eggs
Chopped parsley for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet and saute onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, paprika, oregano, salt, and pepper; simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Crack eggs over the surface of the sauce, spacing evenly.
Cover and cook 8-10 minutes until whites are set and yolks are still soft.
Garnish with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Breakfast Sausages and Veggies
recipes.ingredients:
9 breakfast sausage links
2 cups halved baby potatoes
1 zucchini, sliced
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper
1 tsp dried thyme
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Toss potatoes with oil, salt, pepper, and thyme; spread on a sheet pan and roast 10 minutes.
Add sausages and zucchini to the pan and roast 15 more minutes, turning once, until sausages are cooked through.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Homemade Granola
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups rolled oats
1/2 cup chopped almonds
1/2 cup chopped walnuts
1/3 cup honey
1/4 cup oil
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/2 cup dried cranberries
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 F and line a baking sheet.
Mix oats, almonds, and walnuts in a large bowl.
Whisk honey, oil, vanilla, and cinnamon, then pour over the oat mixture and toss to coat.
Spread evenly on the baking sheet.
Bake 25-30 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden.
Cool completely, then stir in dried cranberries. Store in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Egg and Cheese Breakfast Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
3 English muffins, split
3 eggs
3 slices cheddar cheese
3 slices Canadian bacon
Butter for toasting
recipes.instructions:
Toast the English muffins with a little butter until golden.
Fry the eggs in a skillet to your preference, seasoning with salt and pepper.
Warm the Canadian bacon in the same skillet.
Assemble sandwiches with bacon, egg, and cheese between muffin halves.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Banana Bread
recipes.ingredients:
3 ripe bananas, mashed
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 tsp baking soda
Pinch of salt
1 1/2 cups flour
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and grease a loaf pan.
Mix mashed bananas with melted butter.
Stir in sugar, egg, and vanilla.
Sprinkle baking soda and salt over the mixture and stir in.
Add flour and mix until just combined.
Pour into the loaf pan and bake 55-60 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Breakfast Smoothie Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
2 frozen bananas
1 1/2 cups frozen mixed berries
1 cup milk
3/4 cup plain yogurt
Granola, sliced banana, and chia seeds for topping
recipes.instructions:
Blend frozen bananas, berries, milk, and yogurt until thick and smooth.
Divide among three bowls.
Top with granola, banana slices, and chia seeds.
Serve immediately with spoons.

recipes.title: Corn Griddle Cakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cornmeal
1/2 cup flour
1 tbsp sugar
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup milk
1 egg
2 tbsp melted butter
1 cup corn kernels
recipes.instructions:
Whisk cornmeal, flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk milk, egg, and melted butter in another bowl, then combine with dry ingredients.
Fold in corn kernels.
Cook spoonfuls of batter on a greased griddle over medium heat, flipping once golden.
Serve warm with butter and syrup.

recipes.title: Breakfast Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked, cooled rice
2 tbsp oil
1 carrot, diced
1/2 onion, diced
3 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat.
Add carrot and onion and stir-fry 3-4 minutes until softened.
Push vegetables aside, pour in eggs, and scramble until just set.
Add rice and soy sauce, tossing everything together until heated through.
Stir in green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Yogurt and Honey Toast with Walnuts
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices whole grain bread, toasted
1 1/2 cups plain Greek yogurt
3 tbsp honey
1/3 cup chopped walnuts
Cinnamon for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Toast the bread slices until golden.
Spread each with a generous layer of yogurt.
Drizzle honey over the yogurt.
Sprinkle with chopped walnuts and a dusting of cinnamon.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Breakfast Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1 1/2 cups milk
4 cups cubed bread
1 1/2 cups diced cooked ham
1 cup shredded cheddar
Salt and pepper
1 tsp mustard powder
recipes.instructions:
Grease a baking dish and layer bread cubes, ham, and cheese.
Whisk eggs, milk, salt, pepper, and mustard powder, then pour over the bread mixture.
Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight.
Preheat oven to 350 F and bake, uncovered, 40-45 minutes until puffed and set.
Let stand 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices whole grain bread, toasted
6 tbsp peanut butter
2 bananas, sliced
Honey for drizzling
Cinnamon, optional
recipes.instructions:
Toast the bread until golden.
Spread each slice generously with peanut butter.
Top with banana slices.
Drizzle with honey and dust with cinnamon if using.
Serve right away.

recipes.title: Zucchini Breakfast Bread
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups grated zucchini
2 eggs
1/2 cup oil
3/4 cup sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Pinch of salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and grease a loaf pan.
Squeeze excess water from grated zucchini.
Whisk eggs, oil, sugar, and vanilla.
Stir in zucchini.
Add flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt, mixing until just combined.
Pour into the pan and bake 50-55 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.

recipes.title: Breakfast Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
6 small corn tortillas
6 eggs, scrambled
1 cup diced cooked chorizo or sausage
1/2 cup shredded cheese
Salsa and chopped cilantro for serving
recipes.instructions:
Cook sausage in a skillet until browned; add eggs and scramble together until set.
Warm tortillas in a dry skillet.
Fill tortillas with the egg mixture and top with cheese.
Garnish with salsa and cilantro.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Apple Cinnamon Baked Pancake
recipes.ingredients:
3 eggs
3/4 cup milk
3/4 cup flour
2 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Pinch of salt
2 tbsp butter
1 apple, thinly sliced
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F with an oven-safe skillet inside.
Whisk eggs, milk, flour, sugar, cinnamon, and salt until smooth.
Carefully remove the hot skillet, add butter to melt, then arrange apple slices in the bottom.
Pour batter over the apples.
Bake 20-22 minutes until puffed and golden.
Slice and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Sausage and Sweet Potato Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups diced sweet potato
1 tbsp oil
1 lb breakfast sausage, sliced
1/2 onion, diced
Salt, pepper, and paprika
3 eggs, fried, for serving
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add sweet potato and cook, stirring occasionally, 12 minutes until tender.
Add sausage and onion, cooking until sausage browns and onion softens.
Season with salt, pepper, and paprika.
Top each serving with a fried egg.

recipes.title: Cheesy Grits with Bacon
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups water
3/4 cup grits
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup shredded cheddar
2 tbsp butter
4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
recipes.instructions:
Bring water and salt to a boil in a saucepan.
Whisk in grits and reduce heat to low.
Cook, stirring often, 15-18 minutes until thickened.
Stir in cheese and butter until melted.
Top with crumbled bacon and serve hot.

recipes.title: Multigrain Waffle Sandwiches with Egg and Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
6 frozen multigrain waffles, toasted
3 eggs, fried
3 slices cheese
3 slices ham
Butter for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Toast waffles until crisp.
Fry eggs to your liking in a lightly buttered skillet.
Warm the ham in the same skillet.
Layer ham, egg, and cheese between two waffles per sandwich.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Spice Muffins
recipes.ingredients:
1 3/4 cups flour
1 cup sugar
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
1 cup canned pumpkin puree
1/2 cup oil
2 eggs
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking soda, salt, and pumpkin pie spice.
Whisk pumpkin puree, oil, and eggs in another bowl, then combine with dry ingredients.
Divide batter among muffin cups.
Bake 20-22 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool before serving.

recipes.title: Breakfast Polenta with Berries
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups milk
3/4 cup polenta or cornmeal
2 tbsp sugar
Pinch of salt
1 1/2 cups mixed berries
Honey for drizzling
recipes.instructions:
Bring milk to a gentle simmer in a saucepan.
Whisk in polenta, sugar, and salt.
Cook, stirring frequently, 15 minutes until thick and creamy.
Spoon into bowls and top with berries.
Drizzle with honey and serve warm.

recipes.title: Turkey Sausage Breakfast Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb turkey breakfast sausage, crumbled
2 cups diced potatoes
1 tbsp oil
1 cup baby spinach
3 eggs, fried
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a skillet and cook potatoes until browned and tender, about 12 minutes.
Add turkey sausage and cook until browned through.
Stir in spinach until just wilted.
Divide into bowls and top each with a fried egg.
Season with salt and pepper.

recipes.title: Chia Pudding with Mango
recipes.ingredients:
1/3 cup chia seeds
1 3/4 cups milk
2 tbsp honey
1/2 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/2 cups diced mango
recipes.instructions:
Whisk chia seeds, milk, honey, and vanilla together in a bowl or jar.
Let sit 5 minutes, then whisk again to prevent clumping.
Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight until thickened.
Spoon into bowls or jars and top with diced mango.
Serve chilled.

recipes.title: Spinach and Feta Breakfast Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1 tbsp butter
2 cups baby spinach
1/2 cup crumbled feta
3 large flour tortillas
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs with salt and pepper.
Melt butter in a skillet and wilt the spinach, about 2 minutes.
Pour in eggs and scramble gently until just set, then stir in feta.
Warm tortillas and fill with the egg mixture.
Roll into wraps and serve warm.

recipes.title: Maple Brown Sugar Oatmeal
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups milk or water
1 1/2 cups rolled oats
Pinch of salt
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp maple syrup
Sliced banana for topping
recipes.instructions:
Bring milk or water to a boil in a saucepan.
Stir in oats and salt, then reduce heat to a simmer.
Cook 5-7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until thickened.
Stir in brown sugar and maple syrup.
Top with banana slices and serve warm.

recipes.title: Breakfast Egg Muffin Cups
recipes.ingredients:
8 eggs
1/4 cup milk
1 cup diced cooked ham
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
1/2 cup diced zucchini
1/4 cup diced onion
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and grease a 12-cup muffin tin.
Whisk eggs and milk with salt and pepper.
Divide ham, cheese, zucchini, and onion evenly among the cups.
Pour egg mixture over the fillings, filling each cup about 3/4 full.
Bake 18-20 minutes until eggs are set and lightly golden.
Cool slightly before removing from the tin.

recipes.title: Cornmeal Johnnycakes
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup cornmeal
1 cup boiling water
1/2 cup milk
1 egg
2 tbsp sugar
1/2 tsp salt
Butter or oil for the griddle
recipes.instructions:
Stir boiling water into cornmeal and let stand 5 minutes to soften.
Whisk in milk, egg, sugar, and salt until smooth.
Heat a lightly greased griddle over medium heat.
Spoon batter into small cakes and cook 3-4 minutes per side until golden.
Serve warm with syrup.

recipes.title: Raspberry Almond Baked Oatmeal Cups
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/2 cups rolled oats
1 tsp baking powder
1/2 tsp cinnamon
1/4 tsp salt
2 cups milk
1 egg
1/3 cup honey
1 1/2 cups raspberries
1/3 cup sliced almonds
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F and grease a muffin tin.
Mix oats, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Whisk milk, egg, and honey, then stir into the oat mixture.
Fold in raspberries and almonds.
Divide among muffin cups and bake 20-25 minutes until set and golden.
Cool 5 minutes before removing.

recipes.title: Denver-Style Egg Scramble
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
2 tbsp milk
1 tbsp butter
1/2 cup diced cooked ham
1/2 onion, diced
1/2 cup diced zucchini
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Whisk eggs and milk together.
Melt butter in a skillet and saute onion and zucchini until softened, about 4 minutes.
Add ham and cook 2 minutes to warm through.
Pour in eggs and scramble gently until just set.
Stir in cheese until melted and serve.

recipes.title: Blackberry Yogurt Smoothie
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups blackberries
1 1/2 cups plain yogurt
1 cup milk
2 tbsp honey
1 cup ice
recipes.instructions:
Combine blackberries, yogurt, milk, and honey in a blender.
Add ice and blend until smooth.
Pour into glasses and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Classic Grilled Cheese and Tomato Soup
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices bread
6 slices cheddar cheese
3 tbsp butter
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 cup vegetable broth
1/2 onion, diced
1 tbsp olive oil
1/4 cup cream
recipes.instructions:
Heat olive oil and saute onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add crushed tomatoes and broth; simmer 15 minutes.
Blend soup until smooth, then stir in cream.
Meanwhile, butter bread and assemble sandwiches with cheese.
Grill sandwiches in a skillet over medium heat until golden and cheese melts, about 3 minutes per side.
Serve sandwiches with the warm soup.

recipes.title: Chicken Caesar Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, sliced chicken breast
3 large flour tortillas
3 cups chopped romaine
1/2 cup shredded parmesan
1/3 cup Caesar dressing
Croutons, optional
recipes.instructions:
Toss romaine, parmesan, and dressing together in a bowl.
Warm tortillas slightly to make them pliable.
Layer chicken and salad mixture down the center of each tortilla.
Add croutons if using.
Roll tightly and slice in half to serve.

recipes.title: Turkey and Avocado Club Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
9 slices bread, toasted
3/4 lb sliced deli turkey
6 slices bacon, cooked
1 avocado, sliced
1 tomato, sliced
Lettuce leaves
Mayonnaise
recipes.instructions:
Spread mayonnaise on toasted bread slices.
Layer turkey, bacon, avocado, tomato, and lettuce between the bread, stacking in three layers per sandwich.
Secure with toothpicks and slice diagonally.
Serve with chips or a side salad.

recipes.title: Broccoli Cheddar Soup
recipes.ingredients:
3 tbsp butter
1/2 onion, diced
1 carrot, diced
1/4 cup flour
3 cups chicken or vegetable broth
1 cup milk
3 cups chopped broccoli
2 cups shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter in a pot and saute onion and carrot until soft, about 5 minutes.
Stir in flour and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in broth and milk until smooth.
Add broccoli and simmer 15 minutes until tender.
Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted.
Season to taste and serve warm.

recipes.title: Southwest Chicken Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, diced chicken breast
1 can black beans, rinsed
1 cup corn kernels
1 tomato, diced
1/2 red onion, diced
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
3 tbsp lime juice
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, black beans, corn, tomato, onion, and cilantro in a large bowl.
Whisk lime juice and olive oil, then season with salt and pepper.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss to combine.
Chill 10 minutes before serving for best flavor.

recipes.title: Loaded Baked Potato Soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 large potatoes, peeled and diced
3 cups chicken broth
1 cup milk
4 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
1 cup shredded cheddar
1/4 cup sour cream
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Simmer potatoes in broth until very tender, about 20 minutes.
Mash some of the potatoes directly in the pot to thicken the soup, leaving some chunks.
Stir in milk and half the cheese and bacon; heat through.
Ladle into bowls and top with remaining cheese, bacon, sour cream, and green onions.

recipes.title: Ham and Swiss Panini
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices sourdough bread
3/4 lb sliced deli ham
6 slices Swiss cheese
2 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp butter, softened
recipes.instructions:
Spread mustard on one side of each bread slice.
Layer ham and cheese between two slices per sandwich, mustard sides in.
Butter the outside of each sandwich.
Grill in a skillet or panini press over medium heat until golden and cheese melts, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: Quinoa and Black Bean Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup quinoa
2 cups vegetable broth
1 can black beans, rinsed
1 cup corn kernels
1 avocado, diced
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
2 tbsp lime juice
2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.instructions:
Simmer quinoa in broth, covered, 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed; fluff with a fork.
Stir in black beans and corn and warm through.
Divide among bowls and top with avocado and cilantro.
Whisk lime juice and olive oil and drizzle over each bowl before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Noodle Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
6 cups chicken broth
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
2 cups egg noodles
Salt, pepper, and parsley
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in noodles and cook according to package time until tender.
Add shredded chicken and heat through.
Season with salt, pepper, and parsley before serving.

recipes.title: Mediterranean Chickpea Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans chickpeas, rinsed
1 cucumber, diced
1 tomato, diced
1/2 red onion, diced
1/2 cup crumbled feta
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp lemon juice
1 tsp dried oregano
recipes.instructions:
Combine chickpeas, cucumber, tomato, onion, and feta in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, and oregano.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss well.
Chill 15 minutes before serving to let flavors meld.

recipes.title: BLT Pasta Salad
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups rotini pasta
6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
2 tomatoes, diced
2 cups chopped romaine
1/2 cup mayonnaise
1 tbsp apple cider vinegar
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and cool.
Whisk mayonnaise and vinegar together with salt and pepper.
Toss pasta with dressing, bacon, tomatoes, and romaine just before serving.
Chill briefly if desired and serve.

recipes.title: Turkey Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (15 oz) diced tomatoes
1 can kidney beans, rinsed
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp paprika
1 cup chicken broth
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground turkey with onion and garlic in a large pot until cooked through.
Stir in diced tomatoes, kidney beans, chili powder, paprika, and broth.
Bring to a simmer and cook uncovered 30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Adjust seasoning to taste and serve hot with your favorite toppings.

recipes.title: Egg Salad Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp diced celery
Salt and pepper
6 slices bread
Lettuce leaves
recipes.instructions:
Boil eggs 10-12 minutes, then cool, peel, and chop.
Mix chopped eggs with mayonnaise, mustard, celery, salt, and pepper.
Spread egg salad on bread with lettuce.
Top with remaining bread slices and slice to serve.

recipes.title: Tomato Basil Soup with Grilled Cheese Croutons
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 cans (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
2 cups vegetable broth
1/4 cup fresh basil, chopped
1/4 cup cream
2 slices bread with cheese, grilled and cubed
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion until soft, about 5 minutes.
Add tomatoes and broth; simmer 20 minutes.
Blend until smooth, then stir in basil and cream.
Grill cheese sandwiches separately and cut into small cubes for croutons.
Ladle soup into bowls and top with the cheesy croutons.

recipes.title: Chicken and Rice Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
6 cups chicken broth
1 cup rice
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
Salt, pepper, and thyme
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion, carrots, and celery until softened.
Add broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in rice, reduce heat, and simmer 18-20 minutes until tender.
Add shredded chicken and heat through.
Season with salt, pepper, and thyme before serving.

recipes.title: Caprese Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices ciabatta bread
8 oz fresh mozzarella, sliced
2 tomatoes, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic glaze
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Drizzle bread slices with olive oil.
Layer mozzarella, tomato, and basil on three of the slices.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and season with salt and pepper.
Top with remaining bread slices and slice in half to serve.

recipes.title: Beef and Barley Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef stew meat, cubed
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, sliced
2 celery stalks, sliced
6 cups beef broth
2/3 cup pearl barley
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Brown beef in oil over medium-high heat, then remove and set aside.
Saute onion, carrots, and celery in the same pot until softened.
Return beef to the pot, add broth and barley, and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer covered 45 minutes until beef and barley are tender.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Buffalo Chicken Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
1/3 cup buffalo sauce
3 large flour tortillas
1 cup shredded lettuce
1/2 cup ranch dressing
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Toss shredded chicken with buffalo sauce until coated.
Warm tortillas slightly.
Layer chicken, lettuce, cheddar, and a drizzle of ranch on each tortilla.
Roll tightly and slice in half to serve.

recipes.title: Minestrone Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
1 can diced tomatoes
4 cups vegetable broth
1 can kidney beans, rinsed
1 cup small pasta
2 cups chopped zucchini
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add tomatoes and broth and bring to a boil.
Stir in kidney beans, pasta, and zucchini.
Simmer 12-15 minutes until pasta is tender.
Season to taste and serve with grated parmesan if desired.

recipes.title: Ham and Cheese Sliders
recipes.ingredients:
12 slider buns
3/4 lb sliced deli ham
12 slices Swiss cheese
1/4 cup melted butter
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp poppy seeds
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F.
Slice bun tray in half horizontally and layer ham and cheese on the bottom half.
Replace the top and place in a baking dish.
Whisk melted butter with mustard and poppy seeds, then brush over the tops.
Bake 12-15 minutes until cheese melts and tops are golden.

recipes.title: Cobb Salad
recipes.ingredients:
6 cups chopped romaine
2 cups cooked, diced chicken breast
6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
3 eggs, hard-boiled and quartered
1 avocado, sliced
1 tomato, diced
1/2 cup crumbled blue cheese
1/2 cup ranch dressing
recipes.instructions:
Arrange romaine on a large platter or in individual bowls.
Top with rows of chicken, bacon, eggs, avocado, tomato, and blue cheese.
Drizzle with ranch dressing just before serving or serve on the side.

recipes.title: Pulled Pork Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb pork shoulder
1 onion, sliced
1 cup barbecue sauce
1/4 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp brown sugar
1 tsp smoked paprika
6 buns
Coleslaw for topping
recipes.instructions:
Place onion in the bottom of a slow cooker and set the pork shoulder on top.
Mix barbecue sauce, broth, brown sugar, and paprika, then pour over the pork.
Cover and cook on low 8 hours or high 5-6 hours until very tender.
Shred the pork with two forks and mix with the sauce.
Serve on buns topped with coleslaw.

recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups cooked, cooled rice
2 tbsp oil
1 carrot, diced
1/2 cup diced zucchini
1/2 onion, diced
2 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat.
Stir-fry carrot, zucchini, and onion until just tender, about 4 minutes.
Push vegetables aside, add eggs, and scramble until set.
Add rice and soy sauce, tossing to combine and heat through.
Stir in green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Salad Croissants
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, diced chicken breast
1/3 cup mayonnaise
1/2 cup halved grapes
1/4 cup chopped celery
1/4 cup chopped pecans
3 croissants, split
Lettuce leaves
recipes.instructions:
Combine chicken, mayonnaise, grapes, celery, and pecans in a bowl.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Split croissants and add a lettuce leaf.
Spoon chicken salad onto each croissant.
Serve immediately or chill until ready to eat.

recipes.title: Lentil Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups green or brown lentils
6 cups vegetable broth
1 can diced tomatoes
1 tsp paprika
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion and carrots until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in lentils, broth, tomatoes, and paprika.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender.
Season to taste and serve hot.

recipes.title: Italian Sub Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
1 loaf Italian bread, cut into thirds
1/4 lb sliced salami
1/4 lb sliced ham
1/4 lb sliced provolone
Shredded lettuce
Sliced tomato
Red onion, thinly sliced
Olive oil and red wine vinegar
recipes.instructions:
Split each bread piece and drizzle with olive oil and vinegar.
Layer salami, ham, and provolone on the bottom half of each roll.
Top with lettuce, tomato, and onion.
Close sandwiches and press gently.
Slice in half and serve.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato and Black Bean Burrito Bowl
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups diced sweet potato
1 tbsp oil
1 can black beans, rinsed
1 cup cooked rice
1 cup corn kernels
1 avocado, diced
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
2 tbsp lime juice
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Toss sweet potato with oil and roast on a sheet pan 20-25 minutes until tender.
Warm black beans and corn in a small pot.
Divide rice among bowls and top with sweet potato, beans, corn, and avocado.
Sprinkle with cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice.

recipes.title: Chicken Pesto Panini
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices ciabatta bread
2 cups cooked, sliced chicken breast
1/3 cup basil pesto
6 slices provolone
1 tomato, sliced
2 tbsp butter, softened
recipes.instructions:
Spread pesto on one side of each bread slice.
Layer chicken, provolone, and tomato between two slices per sandwich.
Butter the outside of each sandwich.
Grill in a skillet or panini press over medium heat until golden and cheese melts, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Slice and serve warm.

recipes.title: Greek Chicken Pita Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, cubed
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp oregano
Salt and pepper
3 pita breads
1 cup diced cucumber
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 clove garlic, minced
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with olive oil, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Cook chicken in a skillet over medium-high heat until golden and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Mix yogurt, cucumber, lemon juice, and garlic to make a quick tzatziki.
Warm pitas and fill with chicken and tzatziki.
Serve immediately.

recipes.title: Vegetable Barley Soup
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 celery stalks, diced
2/3 cup pearl barley
6 cups vegetable broth
1 cup diced zucchini
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion, carrots, and celery until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add barley and broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer 30 minutes, adding zucchini in the last 10 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Cajun Chicken Salad
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast
1 tbsp Cajun seasoning
1 tbsp oil
6 cups mixed greens
1 cup halved cherry tomatoes
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
1/3 cup ranch dressing
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with Cajun seasoning.
Cook in oil over medium-high heat 5-6 minutes per side until cooked through, then slice.
Toss mixed greens with cherry tomatoes and cheddar.
Top with sliced chicken.
Drizzle with ranch dressing and serve.

recipes.title: White Bean and Vegetable Salad
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans white beans, rinsed
1 cucumber, diced
1 carrot, grated
1/2 red onion, diced
1/4 cup chopped parsley
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp lemon juice
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Combine white beans, cucumber, carrot, onion, and parsley in a bowl.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice, season with salt and pepper.
Pour dressing over the salad and toss well.
Chill 15 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Chicken Tortilla Soup
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can diced tomatoes
4 cups chicken broth
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
1 cup corn kernels
1 tsp smoked paprika
Tortilla strips and avocado for topping
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion and garlic until soft, about 4 minutes.
Add tomatoes, broth, chicken, corn, and paprika.
Simmer 20 minutes to blend flavors.
Ladle into bowls and top with tortilla strips and avocado.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Roast Beef and Cheddar Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
6 slices rye bread
3/4 lb sliced roast beef
6 slices cheddar cheese
2 tbsp horseradish sauce
Lettuce leaves
Sliced tomato
recipes.instructions:
Spread horseradish sauce on bread slices.
Layer roast beef, cheddar, lettuce, and tomato on three slices.
Top with remaining bread slices.
Slice in half and serve with chips or a pickle.

recipes.title: Vegetable Barley Salad
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup pearl barley
2 1/2 cups water
1 cucumber, diced
1 carrot, grated
1/2 cup halved cherry tomatoes
1/4 cup chopped parsley
3 tbsp olive oil
2 tbsp lemon juice
recipes.instructions:
Simmer barley in water 20-25 minutes until tender; drain and cool.
Combine barley with cucumber, carrot, tomatoes, and parsley.
Whisk olive oil and lemon juice and pour over the salad.
Toss well and season with salt and pepper.
Chill or serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: Pesto Chicken and Vegetable Pasta Salad
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups rotini pasta
2 cups cooked, diced chicken breast
1/3 cup basil pesto
1 cup halved cherry tomatoes
1/2 cup diced zucchini
2 tbsp olive oil
recipes.instructions:
Cook pasta according to package directions; drain and cool slightly.
Toss pasta with pesto and olive oil.
Add chicken, cherry tomatoes, and zucchini and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Chill or serve at room temperature.

recipes.title: French Onion Soup
recipes.ingredients:
4 large onions, thinly sliced
3 tbsp butter
6 cups beef broth
1 tsp thyme
1 baguette, sliced
1 1/2 cups shredded Gruyere
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter in a large pot and cook onions over medium-low heat, stirring often, 30-35 minutes until deeply caramelized.
Add broth and thyme and simmer 15 minutes.
Ladle soup into oven-safe bowls, top with a baguette slice and cheese.
Broil 2-3 minutes until cheese is bubbly and golden.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Wrap
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, diced chicken breast
6 slices bacon, cooked and crumbled
3 large flour tortillas
1 cup shredded lettuce
1/2 cup ranch dressing
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken and bacon with ranch dressing.
Warm tortillas slightly to make them pliable.
Layer chicken mixture, lettuce, and cheddar on each tortilla.
Roll tightly and slice in half to serve.

recipes.title: Roasted Vegetable and Hummus Sandwich
recipes.ingredients:
1 zucchini, sliced
1 carrot, sliced
1 red onion, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
6 slices whole grain bread
1/2 cup hummus
Spinach leaves
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Toss zucchini, carrot, and onion with olive oil and roast 15-18 minutes until tender.
Spread hummus on bread slices.
Layer roasted vegetables and spinach on three slices.
Top with remaining bread and serve warm or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Classic Spaghetti and Meatballs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1/4 cup grated parmesan
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
12 oz spaghetti
Fresh basil for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, parmesan, and garlic; form into meatballs.
Brown meatballs in a skillet over medium heat, then transfer to a pot with marinara sauce.
Simmer meatballs in the sauce 25 minutes, turning occasionally.
Cook spaghetti according to package directions; drain.
Serve spaghetti topped with meatballs and sauce, garnished with basil.

recipes.title: Honey Garlic Chicken Thighs
recipes.ingredients:
6 bone-in chicken thighs
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp oil
1/4 cup honey
3 tbsp soy sauce
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp rice vinegar
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken thighs with salt and pepper.
Sear in oil over medium-high heat, skin side down, until golden, about 5 minutes; flip.
Whisk honey, soy sauce, garlic, and vinegar and pour over the chicken.
Reduce heat and simmer, basting occasionally, 20-25 minutes until cooked through and sauce thickens.
Serve with rice or vegetables.

recipes.title: Beef and Broccoli Stir-Fry
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb flank steak, thinly sliced
3 cups broccoli florets
2 tbsp oil
1/3 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp cornstarch
1/2 cup beef broth
recipes.instructions:
Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, garlic, cornstarch, and broth to make the sauce.
Heat oil in a wok over high heat and sear the steak until browned, about 2 minutes; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli 3-4 minutes until bright and just tender.
Return steak to the pan, add sauce, and cook until thickened, about 2 minutes.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz ziti pasta
1 lb ground beef
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
15 oz ricotta cheese
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated parmesan
1 egg
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Cook ziti until just al dente; drain.
Brown ground beef in a skillet, then stir in marinara sauce.
Mix ricotta with egg and half the parmesan.
Layer pasta, meat sauce, and ricotta mixture in a baking dish, top with mozzarella and remaining parmesan.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Roast Chicken with Root Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
1 whole chicken (about 4 lb)
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp thyme
3 carrots, cut into chunks
3 potatoes, quartered
1 onion, quartered
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Season chicken generously with salt, pepper, and thyme, then rub with olive oil.
Arrange vegetables around the chicken in a roasting pan.
Roast 70-80 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F internally, basting once or twice.
Let rest 10 minutes before carving and serve with the roasted vegetables.

recipes.title: Beef Stroganoff
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb beef sirloin, thinly sliced
2 tbsp butter
1 onion, sliced
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
2 tbsp flour
2 cups beef broth
1/2 cup sour cream
8 oz egg noodles
recipes.instructions:
Cook egg noodles according to package directions; drain.
Sear beef in butter over high heat until browned; remove.
Saute onion and mushrooms in the same pan until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in flour, then gradually whisk in broth until thickened.
Return beef to the pan, stir in sour cream, and heat through without boiling.
Serve over the noodles.

recipes.title: Sheet Pan Sausage and Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb smoked sausage, sliced
2 cups halved baby potatoes
2 zucchini, sliced
1 red onion, cut into wedges
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp Italian seasoning
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Toss potatoes with half the oil and roast 10 minutes.
Add sausage, zucchini, and onion tossed with remaining oil, paprika, and Italian seasoning.
Roast 20 more minutes, stirring once, until vegetables are tender and sausage is browned.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmesan
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts, halved
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated parmesan
2 eggs, beaten
2 cups marinara sauce
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella
12 oz spaghetti
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Dip chicken in egg, then coat in breadcrumbs mixed with parmesan.
Pan-fry chicken in a little oil until golden on both sides.
Transfer to a baking dish, top with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake 15-18 minutes until cheese is melted and chicken is cooked through.
Serve over spaghetti.

recipes.title: Slow Cooker Beef Stew
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb beef stew meat, cubed
2 tbsp flour
1 tbsp oil
3 carrots, sliced
3 potatoes, cubed
1 onion, diced
4 cups beef broth
1 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp thyme
recipes.instructions:
Toss beef with flour and brown in oil in a skillet, then transfer to a slow cooker.
Add carrots, potatoes, onion, broth, tomato paste, and thyme.
Cover and cook on low 8 hours or high 5-6 hours until beef is tender.
Stir well and adjust seasoning before serving.
Serve hot with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Lemon Garlic Baked Chicken Breast
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
2 tbsp olive oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
Zest and juice of 1 lemon
1 tsp oregano
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Whisk olive oil, garlic, lemon zest, lemon juice, oregano, salt, and pepper.
Place chicken in a baking dish and pour marinade over top.
Bake 22-25 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F internally.
Spoon pan juices over the chicken before serving.

recipes.title: Turkey Meatloaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground turkey
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1/4 cup diced onion
1/4 cup ketchup, plus 2 tbsp for topping
1 tbsp Worcestershire sauce
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Mix ground turkey, breadcrumbs, egg, onion, 1/4 cup ketchup, Worcestershire sauce, salt, and pepper.
Shape into a loaf in a baking dish or loaf pan.
Spread remaining ketchup over the top.
Bake 45-50 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165 F.
Let rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Vegetable Stir-Fry with Tofu
recipes.ingredients:
14 oz firm tofu, cubed
2 tbsp oil
2 cups broccoli florets
1 carrot, sliced
1 zucchini, sliced
1/3 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp hoisin sauce
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
recipes.instructions:
Pat tofu dry and sear in 1 tbsp oil until golden on most sides; remove.
Stir-fry broccoli, carrot, and zucchini in remaining oil 4-5 minutes.
Whisk soy sauce and hoisin sauce and add to the pan along with the tofu.
Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until sauce thickens, about 1 minute.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Chicken Fajitas
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, sliced
1 onion, sliced
2 zucchini, sliced into strips
2 tbsp oil
2 tbsp fajita seasoning
6 small flour tortillas
Sour cream and salsa for serving
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with 1 tbsp fajita seasoning.
Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet and cook chicken until browned and cooked through, about 7 minutes; remove.
Add remaining oil, onion, and zucchini to the pan with remaining seasoning; cook until tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the pan and toss together.
Serve with warm tortillas, sour cream, and salsa.

recipes.title: Creamy Chicken and Mushroom Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp butter
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup chicken broth
1/2 cup cream
1 tsp thyme
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper and sear in butter until golden and cooked through, about 6 minutes per side; remove.
Saute mushrooms and garlic in the same pan until softened.
Add broth and simmer 3 minutes, then stir in cream and thyme.
Return chicken to the pan and simmer 5 minutes until sauce thickens slightly.
Serve with mashed potatoes or rice.

recipes.title: Pork Chops with Apples and Onions
recipes.ingredients:
3 bone-in pork chops
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp butter
2 apples, sliced
1 onion, sliced
1/3 cup chicken broth
1 tbsp brown sugar
1/2 tsp cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Season pork chops with salt and pepper.
Sear in butter over medium-high heat 4-5 minutes per side until browned and cooked through; remove.
Add apples and onion to the pan and cook until softened, about 8 minutes.
Stir in broth, brown sugar, and cinnamon; simmer 3 minutes.
Return pork chops to the pan, spoon apples over top, and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable Lasagna
recipes.ingredients:
9 lasagna noodles
2 cups ricotta cheese
1 egg
2 zucchini, sliced
2 carrots, grated
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F and cook lasagna noodles until al dente.
Mix ricotta, egg, and half the parmesan.
Saute zucchini and carrots until just tender.
Layer noodles, marinara, ricotta mixture, vegetables, and mozzarella in a baking dish, repeating twice.
Top with remaining sauce, mozzarella, and parmesan.
Bake covered 30 minutes, then uncovered 10-15 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Chicken Tikka Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, cubed
1/2 cup plain yogurt
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp garam masala
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can (14 oz) tomato sauce
1/2 cup cream
recipes.instructions:
Marinate chicken in yogurt, paprika, and garam masala for at least 15 minutes.
Sear chicken in 1 tbsp oil until browned; remove.
Saute onion and garlic in remaining oil until soft.
Add tomato sauce and simmer 10 minutes, then stir in cream.
Return chicken to the pan and simmer 8-10 minutes until cooked through.
Serve with rice or naan.

recipes.title: Baked Herb Panko Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp dried herbs de Provence
Salt and pepper
1 cup panko breadcrumbs
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Whisk olive oil, mustard, herbs, salt, and pepper and brush over chicken.
Press panko breadcrumbs onto the coated chicken.
Place on a baking sheet and bake 22-25 minutes until golden and cooked through.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Beef Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 packet taco seasoning (or 2 tbsp chili powder blend)
2/3 cup water
9 taco shells
1 cup shredded lettuce
1 cup shredded cheddar
1 tomato, diced
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground beef in a skillet, draining excess fat.
Stir in taco seasoning and water; simmer 5 minutes until thickened.
Warm taco shells according to package directions.
Fill shells with beef and top with lettuce, cheddar, and tomato.
Serve with salsa or sour cream if desired.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites with Potatoes
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb sirloin steak, cubed
2 cups baby potatoes, halved
3 tbsp butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Boil potatoes until fork-tender, about 12 minutes; drain.
Melt 1 tbsp butter in a skillet and sear steak bites over high heat 2-3 minutes until browned; remove.
Add remaining butter, garlic, and potatoes to the pan and cook until golden, about 5 minutes.
Return steak to the pan and toss together.
Garnish with parsley and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Pot Pie
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, diced chicken
3 tbsp butter
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
1/3 cup flour
2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup milk
1 cup diced potatoes, cooked
1 sheet puff pastry
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Melt butter and saute onion and carrots until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in flour and cook 1 minute, then whisk in broth and milk until thickened.
Add chicken and potatoes and stir to combine; pour into a baking dish.
Top with puff pastry, cut a few vents, and bake 25-30 minutes until golden and bubbly.

recipes.title: Shepherd's Pie with Beef
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
1 cup corn kernels
1 cup beef broth
2 tbsp tomato paste
4 cups mashed potatoes
1/2 cup shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Brown ground beef with onion and carrots until cooked through.
Stir in corn, broth, and tomato paste; simmer 10 minutes until thickened.
Spread the meat mixture in a baking dish and top with mashed potatoes and cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until golden on top.
Let cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Teriyaki Chicken Rice Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
1/3 cup soy sauce
1/4 cup brown sugar
2 tbsp rice vinegar
1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water
2 cups cooked rice
1 cup steamed broccoli
recipes.instructions:
Whisk soy sauce, brown sugar, and rice vinegar in a saucepan and bring to a simmer.
Sear chicken in a skillet until browned and cooked through, about 8 minutes.
Add the sauce to the chicken and stir in cornstarch slurry, cooking until thickened.
Serve chicken over rice with steamed broccoli on the side.

recipes.title: Stuffed Zucchini Boats
recipes.ingredients:
3 large zucchini, halved lengthwise
1 lb ground beef
1/2 onion, diced
1 cup cooked rice
1 cup marinara sauce
1 cup shredded mozzarella
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Scoop out the center of each zucchini half to form boats; chop the scooped flesh.
Brown ground beef with onion and the chopped zucchini flesh.
Stir in rice and marinara sauce; season with salt and pepper.
Fill the zucchini boats with the mixture, top with mozzarella, and bake 25-30 minutes until zucchini is tender.

recipes.title: Chicken and Vegetable Curry
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken thighs, cubed
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp curry powder
1 can (14 oz) coconut milk
2 cups diced potatoes
1 cup diced carrots
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion and garlic until soft, about 4 minutes.
Stir in curry powder and cook 1 minute until fragrant.
Add chicken and cook until lightly browned.
Add coconut milk, potatoes, and carrots; simmer 20-25 minutes until vegetables are tender and chicken is cooked through.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Baked Ziti with Sausage
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz ziti pasta
1 lb Italian sausage, casings removed
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
15 oz ricotta cheese
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1 egg
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Cook ziti until just al dente; drain.
Brown sausage in a skillet, breaking it up, then stir in marinara sauce.
Mix ricotta with egg.
Layer pasta, meat sauce, and ricotta in a baking dish, top with mozzarella.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken Fajita Bowls
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, sliced
1 onion, sliced
2 zucchini, sliced
2 tbsp oil
2 tbsp fajita seasoning
2 cups cooked rice
1 avocado, diced
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken with half the fajita seasoning.
Cook chicken in 1 tbsp oil until browned and cooked through; remove.
Saute onion and zucchini in remaining oil with remaining seasoning until tender-crisp.
Return chicken to the pan and toss together.
Serve over rice topped with avocado.

recipes.title: Meatball Subs
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
1/4 cup grated parmesan
2 cups marinara sauce
3 sub rolls
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, egg, and parmesan; form into meatballs.
Brown meatballs in a skillet, then simmer in marinara sauce 20 minutes.
Split sub rolls and fill with meatballs and sauce.
Top with mozzarella and broil 2-3 minutes until melted.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Marsala
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts, halved and pounded thin
1/3 cup flour
3 tbsp butter
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
3/4 cup marsala wine
1/2 cup chicken broth
2 tbsp cream
recipes.instructions:
Dredge chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Sear in 2 tbsp butter until golden on both sides and cooked through; remove.
Saute mushrooms in remaining butter until browned.
Add marsala wine and broth; simmer 5 minutes to reduce slightly.
Stir in cream, return chicken to the pan, and simmer 3-4 minutes to heat through.

recipes.title: Pork Carnitas Tacos
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb pork shoulder, cubed
1 onion, quartered
2 cloves garlic
1 tbsp paprika
1 tsp oregano
1 cup chicken broth
9 small corn tortillas
Chopped cilantro and diced onion for serving
recipes.instructions:
Season pork with paprika and oregano and place in a slow cooker with onion, garlic, and broth.
Cover and cook on low 8 hours or high 4 hours until very tender.
Shred pork with two forks and toss with the cooking liquid.
For crispy edges, broil the shredded pork on a sheet pan for a few minutes.
Serve in warm tortillas with cilantro and onion.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Drumsticks with Roasted Vegetables
recipes.ingredients:
9 chicken drumsticks
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper
3 carrots, cut into chunks
2 zucchini, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Toss drumsticks with 1 tbsp oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Toss carrots and zucchini with remaining oil and season lightly.
Arrange chicken and vegetables on a sheet pan.
Roast 35-40 minutes until chicken reaches 165 F internally and vegetables are tender.

recipes.title: Creamy Tuscan-Style Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp butter
3 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes, chopped
1 cup cream
1/2 cup grated parmesan
2 cups baby spinach
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper and sear in butter until golden and cooked through; remove.
Saute garlic and sun-dried tomatoes in the same pan 1 minute.
Stir in cream and parmesan; simmer until slightly thickened.
Add spinach and cook until wilted.
Return chicken to the pan, spoon sauce over top, and serve.

recipes.title: Vegetable and Bean Enchiladas
recipes.ingredients:
9 corn tortillas
1 can black beans, rinsed
1 cup corn kernels
1 zucchini, diced
2 cups enchilada sauce
2 cups shredded cheddar
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Saute zucchini until just tender, then mix with black beans and corn.
Warm tortillas slightly to make them pliable.
Fill each tortilla with the vegetable mixture and roll, placing seam side down in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over top and sprinkle with cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly, then garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Grilled Chicken with Chimichurri
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
2 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper
1 cup chopped parsley
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1/3 cup olive oil for the sauce
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt, pepper, and 2 tbsp olive oil, then grill or pan-sear 6-7 minutes per side until cooked through.
Combine parsley, garlic, vinegar, and remaining olive oil for the chimichurri sauce.
Let chicken rest 5 minutes, then slice.
Spoon chimichurri over the sliced chicken and serve.

recipes.title: Baked Macaroni and Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz elbow macaroni
4 tbsp butter
1/4 cup flour
2 1/2 cups milk
3 cups shredded cheddar
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Cook macaroni until al dente; drain.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, and cook 1 minute.
Gradually whisk in milk until thickened, then stir in cheddar until melted.
Combine sauce with macaroni, pour into a baking dish, top with breadcrumbs.
Bake 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbly.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Skewers
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb sirloin steak, cubed
1 zucchini, sliced into rounds
1 red onion, cut into chunks
8 oz mushrooms, halved
1/3 cup olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
2 cloves garlic, minced
recipes.instructions:
Whisk olive oil, balsamic vinegar, and garlic; toss with the steak and vegetables.
Marinate 20 minutes.
Thread steak and vegetables onto skewers, alternating pieces.
Grill or broil 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until steak reaches desired doneness.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Alfredo
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz fettuccine
2 boneless chicken breasts, sliced
3 tbsp butter
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 1/2 cups cream
1 cup grated parmesan
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Cook fettuccine according to package directions; drain.
Season chicken with salt and pepper and cook in 1 tbsp butter until golden and cooked through; remove and slice.
Melt remaining butter and saute garlic 1 minute.
Add cream and parmesan, whisking until smooth and slightly thickened.
Toss pasta and chicken in the sauce and serve.

recipes.title: Sweet and Sour Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, cubed
1/3 cup cornstarch
2 tbsp oil
1 cup pineapple chunks
1 zucchini, sliced
1/3 cup ketchup
1/4 cup rice vinegar
3 tbsp brown sugar
2 tbsp soy sauce
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken in cornstarch and pan-fry in oil until golden and cooked through; remove.
Stir-fry zucchini 3 minutes.
Whisk ketchup, vinegar, brown sugar, and soy sauce and add to the pan with pineapple.
Simmer until sauce thickens, then return chicken to the pan and toss to coat.
Serve over rice.

recipes.title: Herb-Roasted Pork Tenderloin
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb pork tenderloin
2 tbsp olive oil
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp rosemary
1 tsp thyme
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Rub pork tenderloin with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Sear in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat 2-3 minutes per side until browned.
Transfer skillet to the oven and roast 18-20 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145 F.
Let rest 5 minutes before slicing.

recipes.title: Vegetable and Chickpea Stew
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can diced tomatoes
2 cans chickpeas, rinsed
2 cups vegetable broth
2 cups chopped kale
1 tsp paprika
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion and carrots until softened, about 6 minutes.
Add garlic and cook 1 minute.
Stir in tomatoes, chickpeas, broth, and paprika; bring to a simmer.
Cook 20 minutes, then stir in kale and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Fried Rice Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, diced
2 tbsp oil
1 carrot, diced
1/2 onion, diced
3 cups cooked, cooled rice
2 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Cook chicken in 1 tbsp oil over medium-high heat until browned and cooked through; remove.
Stir-fry carrot and onion in remaining oil 3-4 minutes.
Push vegetables aside, scramble eggs in the pan.
Add rice, chicken, and soy sauce, tossing to combine and heat through.
Stir in green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Braised Short Ribs
recipes.ingredients:
3 lb bone-in beef short ribs
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
2 carrots, diced
2 cups beef broth
1 cup red wine
2 tbsp tomato paste
1 tsp thyme
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 F.
Season ribs with salt and pepper and sear in oil until browned on all sides; remove.
Saute onion and carrots in the same pot until softened.
Stir in tomato paste, then add broth, wine, and thyme, scraping up browned bits.
Return ribs to the pot, cover, and braise in the oven 2 1/2 hours until fork-tender.
Skim excess fat and serve with the braising liquid.

recipes.title: Chicken and Vegetable Kebabs with Rice Pilaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, cubed
1 zucchini, sliced
1 red onion, cut into chunks
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp oregano
1 1/2 cups rice
2 1/2 cups chicken broth
recipes.instructions:
Toss chicken and vegetables with olive oil, paprika, and oregano.
Thread onto skewers and grill or broil 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until chicken is cooked through.
Meanwhile, simmer rice in broth, covered, 15-18 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Fluff rice and serve alongside the kebabs.

recipes.title: Skillet Lasagna
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
2 cups broken lasagna noodles
1 cup ricotta cheese
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella
Basil for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground beef with onion in a large skillet.
Stir in marinara sauce, broken noodles, and 1 1/2 cups water; bring to a simmer.
Cover and cook 15-18 minutes, stirring occasionally, until noodles are tender.
Dollop ricotta over the top and sprinkle with mozzarella.
Cover until cheese melts, then garnish with basil and serve.

recipes.title: Balsamic Glazed Pork Chops
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless pork chops
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp oil
1/3 cup balsamic vinegar
2 tbsp brown sugar
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp rosemary
recipes.instructions:
Season pork chops with salt and pepper and sear in oil until browned and cooked through, about 5 minutes per side; remove.
Whisk balsamic vinegar, brown sugar, garlic, and rosemary in the same pan and simmer until slightly thickened.
Return pork chops to the pan and spoon the glaze over top.
Serve with roasted vegetables or potatoes.

recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Noodles
recipes.ingredients:
10 oz lo mein noodles
2 tbsp oil
1 carrot, julienned
1 cup shredded cabbage
1/2 onion, sliced
1/3 cup soy sauce
2 tbsp hoisin sauce
2 eggs, beaten
recipes.instructions:
Cook noodles according to package directions; drain.
Heat oil in a wok and stir-fry carrot, cabbage, and onion until tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.
Push vegetables aside and scramble eggs in the pan.
Add noodles, soy sauce, and hoisin sauce, tossing to combine.
Cook 2-3 minutes until heated through and serve.

recipes.title: Oven-Baked Chicken Fajita Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, sliced
1 onion, sliced
2 zucchini, sliced
2 tbsp fajita seasoning
2 tbsp oil
2 cups cooked rice
1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Toss chicken and vegetables with oil and fajita seasoning.
Spread rice in a baking dish and top with the chicken and vegetable mixture.
Cover and bake 25 minutes.
Uncover, sprinkle with cheese, and bake 8-10 more minutes until cheese melts and chicken is cooked through.

recipes.title: Chicken Quesadillas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
2 cups shredded cheddar
6 large flour tortillas
2 tbsp butter
Salsa and sour cream for serving
recipes.instructions:
Lay three tortillas flat and top each with chicken and cheese, then close with remaining tortillas.
Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Cook each quesadilla 3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges.
Serve with salsa and sour cream.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
3 cups cooked, cooled rice
2 tbsp oil
1 carrot, diced
1/2 cup diced zucchini
2 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground beef in a large skillet or wok; remove.
Heat oil and stir-fry carrot and zucchini until tender-crisp.
Push vegetables aside, scramble eggs in the pan.
Add rice, beef, and soy sauce, tossing to combine and heat through.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Stuffed Shells with Spinach and Ricotta
recipes.ingredients:
20 jumbo pasta shells
15 oz ricotta cheese
2 cups chopped spinach, wilted and drained
1 egg
1/2 cup grated parmesan
2 cups marinara sauce
1 cup shredded mozzarella
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Cook pasta shells according to package directions; drain and cool slightly.
Mix ricotta, spinach, egg, and parmesan.
Spread a layer of marinara in a baking dish, fill shells with the ricotta mixture, and arrange in the dish.
Top with remaining marinara and mozzarella.
Bake covered 20 minutes, then uncovered 10 minutes until bubbly.

recipes.title: Chicken Enchilada Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
8 corn tortillas, cut into strips
2 cups enchilada sauce
2 cups shredded cheddar
1/2 onion, diced
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Layer tortilla strips, chicken, onion, enchilada sauce, and cheese in a baking dish, repeating to use all ingredients, ending with cheese on top.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.
Garnish with cilantro before serving.

recipes.title: Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz linguine
1 lb chicken breast, cubed
4 tbsp butter
4 cloves garlic, minced
1/2 cup chicken broth
1/4 cup chopped parsley
Salt, pepper, and red pepper flakes
recipes.instructions:
Cook linguine according to package directions; drain, reserving 1/2 cup pasta water.
Season chicken with salt and pepper and cook in 2 tbsp butter until golden and cooked through; remove.
Melt remaining butter and saute garlic 1 minute.
Add broth and a splash of pasta water; simmer 2 minutes.
Toss in pasta and chicken, garnish with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Oven-Baked BBQ Chicken
recipes.ingredients:
6 chicken drumsticks or thighs
Salt and pepper
1 cup barbecue sauce
1 tbsp honey
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Season chicken with salt and pepper and place on a lined baking sheet.
Bake 20 minutes.
Whisk barbecue sauce and honey, brush over the chicken, and bake 12-15 more minutes until glazed and cooked through.
Serve with extra sauce on the side.

recipes.title: Vegetable and White Bean Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 zucchini, diced
1 can diced tomatoes
2 cans white beans, rinsed
2 cups chopped kale
1 tsp oregano
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil and saute onion and garlic until soft, about 4 minutes.
Add zucchini and cook 5 minutes until just tender.
Stir in tomatoes, white beans, and oregano; simmer 10 minutes.
Add kale and cook until wilted, about 3 minutes.
Season to taste and serve with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Chicken Piccata
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts, halved and pounded thin
1/3 cup flour
3 tbsp butter
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 cup chicken broth
1/4 cup lemon juice
2 tbsp capers
2 tbsp chopped parsley
recipes.instructions:
Dredge chicken in flour, shaking off excess.
Sear in butter and olive oil until golden on both sides and cooked through; remove.
Add broth and lemon juice to the pan, scraping up browned bits.
Stir in capers and simmer 3 minutes to reduce slightly.
Return chicken to the pan, spoon sauce over top, garnish with parsley, and serve.

recipes.title: Meatball and Vegetable Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1 egg
2 tbsp oil
2 zucchini, sliced
1 onion, sliced
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
1/2 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Mix ground beef, breadcrumbs, and egg; form into small meatballs.
Brown meatballs in oil in a large skillet, then remove.
Saute zucchini and onion in the same skillet until softened.
Add marinara sauce and return meatballs to the pan; simmer 15 minutes until meatballs are cooked through.
Sprinkle with parmesan and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Sausage and Zucchini Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken sausage links, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
2 zucchini, sliced
1 onion, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp Italian seasoning
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Cook sausage slices until browned, about 6 minutes; remove.
Add zucchini, onion, and garlic to the pan and cook until tender, about 8 minutes.
Stir in Italian seasoning, salt, and pepper.
Return sausage to the pan, toss together, and serve.

recipes.title: Turkey and Vegetable Chili
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground turkey
1 onion, diced
1 zucchini, diced
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 can diced tomatoes
1 can kidney beans, rinsed
2 tbsp chili powder
1 tsp paprika
1 cup chicken broth
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground turkey with onion, zucchini, and garlic until cooked through.
Stir in tomatoes, kidney beans, chili powder, paprika, and broth.
Bring to a simmer and cook 25-30 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Adjust seasoning to taste.
Serve hot with shredded cheese or cornbread.

recipes.title: Honey Mustard Baked Pork Chops
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless pork chops
3 tbsp Dijon mustard
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp olive oil
Salt and pepper
1 tsp thyme
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Whisk mustard, honey, olive oil, salt, pepper, and thyme.
Place pork chops in a baking dish and coat with the mustard mixture.
Bake 20-25 minutes until cooked through, basting once with pan juices.
Let rest a few minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Vegetable Fried Quinoa
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup quinoa
2 cups water
2 tbsp oil
1 carrot, diced
1/2 cup diced zucchini
1/2 onion, diced
2 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
recipes.instructions:
Simmer quinoa in water, covered, 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed; fluff and cool slightly.
Heat oil and stir-fry carrot, zucchini, and onion until tender-crisp.
Push vegetables aside and scramble eggs in the pan.
Add quinoa and soy sauce, tossing to combine and heat through.
Serve hot.

recipes.title: Beef Enchiladas
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground beef
1 onion, diced
9 corn tortillas
2 cups enchilada sauce
2 cups shredded cheddar
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Brown ground beef with onion until cooked through.
Warm tortillas slightly, fill with beef mixture and a little cheese, and roll, placing seam side down in a baking dish.
Pour enchilada sauce over the top and sprinkle with remaining cheese.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly, then garnish with cilantro.

recipes.title: Rosemary Garlic Roasted Pork Loin
recipes.ingredients:
2 lb boneless pork loin
2 tbsp olive oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tbsp rosemary
Salt and pepper
3 carrots, cut into chunks
3 potatoes, quartered
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Rub pork loin with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, salt, and pepper.
Place in a roasting pan surrounded by carrots and potatoes.
Roast 55-60 minutes until internal temperature reaches 145 F, turning vegetables once.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing and serve with the vegetables.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Chimichangas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, shredded chicken
1 cup shredded cheddar
1/2 cup sour cream
1 tsp smoked paprika
6 large flour tortillas
2 tbsp melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Mix chicken, cheddar, sour cream, and smoked paprika.
Divide filling among tortillas and roll into tight burritos, tucking in the ends.
Place seam side down on a baking sheet and brush with melted butter.
Bake 20-25 minutes, turning once, until golden and crisp.
Serve with salsa and extra sour cream.

recipes.title: Chicken and Wild Rice Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, diced chicken
1 cup wild rice blend, cooked
2 tbsp butter
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
1/2 onion, diced
1 cup chicken broth
1/2 cup cream
1 cup shredded cheddar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Melt butter and saute mushrooms and onion until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir in broth and cream, then combine with chicken and cooked rice.
Pour into a baking dish and top with cheddar.
Bake 25-30 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Grilled Flank Steak with Chimichurri
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 lb flank steak
Salt and pepper
1 cup chopped parsley
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 tbsp red wine vinegar
1/3 cup olive oil
1/2 tsp red pepper flakes
recipes.instructions:
Season steak generously with salt and pepper.
Grill or pan-sear 5-6 minutes per side for medium-rare, then let rest 10 minutes.
Combine parsley, garlic, vinegar, olive oil, and red pepper flakes for the chimichurri.
Slice steak thinly against the grain.
Spoon chimichurri over the steak and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken and Broccoli Alfredo Bake
recipes.ingredients:
12 oz penne pasta
2 cups cooked, diced chicken
2 cups broccoli florets, blanched
2 cups alfredo sauce
1 1/2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Cook penne until al dente; drain.
Toss pasta with chicken, broccoli, and alfredo sauce.
Pour into a baking dish and top with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Pork Fried Rice
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb ground pork
3 cups cooked, cooled rice
2 tbsp oil
1 carrot, diced
1/2 cup diced zucchini
2 eggs, beaten
3 tbsp soy sauce
2 green onions, sliced
recipes.instructions:
Brown ground pork in a large skillet or wok; remove.
Heat oil and stir-fry carrot and zucchini until tender-crisp, about 4 minutes.
Push vegetables aside and scramble eggs in the pan.
Add rice, pork, and soy sauce, tossing to combine and heat through.
Stir in green onions and serve.

recipes.title: Chicken Cacciatore
recipes.ingredients:
6 bone-in chicken thighs
Salt and pepper
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, sliced
8 oz mushrooms, sliced
1 can (28 oz) crushed tomatoes
1 tsp oregano
1/2 cup chicken broth
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper and sear in olive oil until golden; remove.
Saute onion and mushrooms in the same pan until softened.
Add crushed tomatoes, oregano, and broth; bring to a simmer.
Return chicken to the pan, cover, and simmer 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through.
Serve over pasta or with crusty bread.

recipes.title: Beef and Vegetable Kebabs over Rice Pilaf
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb sirloin steak, cubed
1 zucchini, sliced
1 red onion, cut into chunks
8 oz mushrooms, halved
1/3 cup olive oil
2 tbsp balsamic vinegar
1 1/2 cups rice
2 1/2 cups beef broth
recipes.instructions:
Whisk olive oil and balsamic vinegar; toss with steak and vegetables and marinate 15 minutes.
Thread onto skewers, alternating pieces.
Grill or broil 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until steak reaches desired doneness.
Meanwhile, simmer rice in broth, covered, 15-18 minutes until liquid is absorbed.
Serve kebabs over the rice pilaf.

recipes.title: Chicken Divan
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups cooked, diced chicken
3 cups broccoli florets, blanched
2 tbsp butter
2 tbsp flour
1 1/2 cups chicken broth
1/2 cup cream
1 cup shredded cheddar
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Melt butter, whisk in flour, then gradually whisk in broth and cream until thickened.
Stir in half the cheddar.
Layer chicken and broccoli in a baking dish, pour sauce over top, and sprinkle with remaining cheddar and breadcrumbs.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Skillet Chicken and Rice
recipes.ingredients:
6 boneless chicken thighs
Salt and pepper
1 tbsp oil
1 onion, diced
1 1/2 cups rice
2 1/2 cups chicken broth
1 cup frozen mixed vegetables (carrots and green beans)
recipes.instructions:
Season chicken with salt and pepper and sear in oil until golden; remove.
Saute onion in the same pan until softened.
Stir in rice and broth, then nestle chicken back into the pan.
Cover and simmer 20 minutes until rice is tender and chicken is cooked through, stirring in mixed vegetables during the last 5 minutes.
Let rest 5 minutes before serving.

recipes.title: Garlic Herb Roasted Turkey Breast
recipes.ingredients:
1 boneless turkey breast (about 3 lb)
3 tbsp olive oil
3 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp rosemary
1 tsp thyme
Salt and pepper
1 cup chicken broth
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F.
Rub turkey breast with olive oil, garlic, rosemary, thyme, salt, and pepper.
Place in a roasting pan with broth poured around it.
Roast 70-75 minutes until internal temperature reaches 165 F, basting occasionally.
Let rest 10 minutes before slicing and serve with pan juices.

recipes.title: Vegetable and Cheese Quesadillas
recipes.ingredients:
1 zucchini, diced
1/2 onion, diced
1 tbsp oil
2 cups shredded cheddar
6 large flour tortillas
2 tbsp butter
recipes.instructions:
Saute zucchini and onion in oil until tender, about 6 minutes.
Lay three tortillas flat, top with the vegetable mixture and cheese, then close with remaining tortillas.
Melt butter in a skillet and cook each quesadilla 3 minutes per side until golden and cheese melts.
Cut into wedges and serve with salsa.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken and Vegetable Foil Packets
recipes.ingredients:
3 boneless chicken breasts
2 cups baby potatoes, halved
2 zucchini, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp paprika
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F or grill to medium-high.
Toss potatoes, zucchini, and chicken with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Divide among three sheets of foil and fold into sealed packets.
Bake or grill 25-30 minutes until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are tender.
Carefully open packets and serve.

recipes.title: Sausage and White Bean Skillet
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb Italian sausage, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1 onion, sliced
2 cloves garlic, minced
2 cans white beans, rinsed
1 cup chicken broth
2 cups chopped kale
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Brown sausage slices in olive oil; remove.
Saute onion and garlic in the same pan until soft.
Add white beans and broth; simmer 8 minutes.
Stir in kale and cook until wilted, then return sausage to the pan.
Season with salt and pepper and serve hot.

recipes.title: Chicken Souvlaki-Style Skewers
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb chicken breast, cubed
1/3 cup olive oil
3 tbsp lemon juice
2 cloves garlic, minced
1 tsp oregano
Salt and pepper
1 cup plain yogurt for serving
1 cucumber, diced, for serving
recipes.instructions:
