Whisk olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano, salt, and pepper; toss with chicken and marinate 15 minutes.
Thread chicken onto skewers.
Grill or broil 10-12 minutes, turning occasionally, until cooked through.
Stir cucumber into yogurt for a quick sauce.
Serve skewers with the yogurt sauce and warm flatbread.

recipes.title: Baked Ravioli Casserole
recipes.ingredients:
2 packages (20 oz each) cheese ravioli
1 jar (24 oz) marinara sauce
1 lb ground beef
2 cups shredded mozzarella
1/2 cup grated parmesan
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Brown ground beef and stir in marinara sauce.
Cook ravioli according to package directions; drain gently.
Layer ravioli and meat sauce in a baking dish, topping with mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake 20-25 minutes until bubbly and golden.

recipes.title: Homemade Hummus with Veggie Dippers
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans chickpeas, rinsed
1/3 cup tahini
1/4 cup lemon juice
2 cloves garlic
3 tbsp olive oil
Salt to taste
Carrot and celery sticks for serving
recipes.instructions:
Combine chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, and garlic in a food processor.
Blend, drizzling in olive oil, until smooth, adding water as needed for consistency.
Season with salt to taste.
Transfer to a bowl and serve with carrot and celery sticks.

recipes.title: Baked Cinnamon Sugar Pita Chips
recipes.ingredients:
4 pita breads, cut into wedges
3 tbsp melted butter
1/4 cup sugar
1 tbsp cinnamon
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Brush pita wedges with melted butter on both sides.
Mix sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle generously over the wedges.
Arrange on a baking sheet and bake 10-12 minutes until crisp and golden.
Cool slightly before serving.

recipes.title: Trail Mix with Nuts and Dried Fruit
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup almonds
1 cup cashews
1 cup pretzels
1 cup dried cranberries
1 cup mini pretzel sticks
1/2 cup dark chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Combine almonds, cashews, pretzels, dried cranberries, and chocolate chips in a large bowl.
Toss well to distribute evenly.
Store in an airtight container or portion into small bags.
Enjoy as a quick grab-and-go snack.

recipes.title: Baked Sweet Potato Fries
recipes.ingredients:
2 large sweet potatoes, cut into fries
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Toss sweet potato fries with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet.
Bake 25-30 minutes, flipping halfway, until crisp and golden.
Serve hot with ketchup or aioli.

recipes.title: Caprese Skewers
recipes.ingredients:
20 cherry tomatoes
20 small mozzarella balls
Fresh basil leaves
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tbsp balsamic glaze
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Thread a cherry tomato, basil leaf, and mozzarella ball onto small skewers.
Arrange on a platter.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic glaze.
Season with salt and pepper and serve chilled or at room temperature.

recipes.title: Crispy Baked Chickpeas
recipes.ingredients:
2 cans chickpeas, rinsed and dried
2 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Toss chickpeas with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, and salt.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake 25-30 minutes, shaking the pan occasionally, until crispy.
Cool slightly before serving; store leftovers in a loosely covered container.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Energy Bites
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup peanut butter
1/3 cup honey
1/2 cup mini chocolate chips
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Mix oats, peanut butter, honey, chocolate chips, and vanilla in a bowl until well combined.
Chill the mixture 15 minutes to firm up.
Roll into 1-inch balls.
Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Cheesy Baked Tortilla Chips
recipes.ingredients:
8 small corn tortillas, cut into wedges
2 tbsp olive oil
1 cup shredded cheddar
1/2 tsp chili powder
Salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Brush tortilla wedges with olive oil and arrange on a baking sheet.
Sprinkle with cheese, chili powder, and salt.
Bake 8-10 minutes until crisp and cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve with salsa for dipping.

recipes.title: Deviled Eggs
recipes.ingredients:
6 eggs
1/4 cup mayonnaise
1 tsp Dijon mustard
1 tsp white vinegar
Salt and pepper
Paprika for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Boil eggs 10-12 minutes, then cool, peel, and halve.
Scoop yolks into a bowl and mash with mayonnaise, mustard, and vinegar.
Season with salt and pepper.
Spoon or pipe the yolk mixture back into the egg whites.
Dust with paprika and chill until serving.

recipes.title: No-Bake Granola Bars
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups rolled oats
1/2 cup honey
1/2 cup peanut butter
1/3 cup mini chocolate chips
1/4 cup chopped almonds
recipes.instructions:
Warm honey and peanut butter together until smooth and pourable.
Stir in oats, almonds, and chocolate chips until well coated.
Press mixture firmly into a lined 8x8 pan.
Refrigerate at least 1 hour until firm.
Cut into bars and store in the refrigerator.

recipes.title: Roasted Spiced Almonds
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups raw almonds
1 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp smoked paprika
1/2 tsp garlic powder
1/2 tsp salt
1/4 tsp cayenne, optional
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F.
Toss almonds with olive oil, paprika, garlic powder, salt, and cayenne if using.
Spread on a baking sheet in a single layer.
Roast 12-15 minutes, stirring halfway, until fragrant.
Cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Cucumber Bites with Cream Cheese
recipes.ingredients:
2 cucumbers, sliced into rounds
8 oz cream cheese, softened
1 tbsp chopped dill
1 tsp lemon zest
Cherry tomato halves for garnish
recipes.instructions:
Mix cream cheese with dill and lemon zest until smooth.
Pipe or spread a small dollop onto each cucumber round.
Top each with a cherry tomato half.
Arrange on a platter and serve chilled.

recipes.title: Air-Fryer Zucchini Chips
recipes.ingredients:
2 zucchini, thinly sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
1/2 cup breadcrumbs
1/4 cup grated parmesan
1 tsp garlic powder
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Toss zucchini slices with olive oil.
Mix breadcrumbs, parmesan, garlic powder, salt, and pepper.
Dredge zucchini slices in the breadcrumb mixture.
Air fry at 380 F for 12-15 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.
Serve immediately with marinara for dipping.

recipes.title: Fruit and Yogurt Popsicles
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups plain yogurt
2 tbsp honey
1 1/2 cups mixed berries, pureed
1/2 cup diced strawberries
recipes.instructions:
Mix yogurt and honey together.
Swirl in pureed berries and fold in diced strawberries.
Spoon mixture into popsicle molds.
Freeze at least 5 hours or overnight until solid.
Run molds briefly under warm water to release before serving.

recipes.title: Baked Zucchini Fritters
recipes.ingredients:
2 zucchini, grated and squeezed dry
1/2 cup flour
1 egg
1/4 cup grated parmesan
2 green onions, sliced
Salt and pepper
Oil for the pan
recipes.instructions:
Mix grated zucchini with flour, egg, parmesan, green onions, salt, and pepper.
Heat a thin layer of oil in a skillet over medium heat.
Drop spoonfuls of batter into the pan and flatten slightly.
Cook 3-4 minutes per side until golden and crisp.
Serve warm with a dollop of sour cream.

recipes.title: Popcorn with Parmesan and Herbs
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup popcorn kernels
2 tbsp oil
3 tbsp melted butter
1/3 cup grated parmesan
1 tsp Italian seasoning
Salt to taste
recipes.instructions:
Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat, add a few kernels, and cover.
Once they pop, add remaining kernels, cover, and shake occasionally until popping slows.
Transfer to a bowl and toss with melted butter.
Sprinkle with parmesan, Italian seasoning, and salt.
Toss again and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Mini Caprese Toasts
recipes.ingredients:
1 baguette, sliced
2 tbsp olive oil
8 oz fresh mozzarella, sliced
2 tomatoes, sliced
Fresh basil leaves
Balsamic glaze
recipes.instructions:
Brush baguette slices with olive oil and toast until lightly golden.
Top each toast with a slice of mozzarella and tomato.
Add a basil leaf to each.
Drizzle with balsamic glaze and serve immediately.

recipes.title: Baked Apple Chips
recipes.ingredients:
3 apples, very thinly sliced
1 tsp cinnamon
1 tbsp sugar, optional
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 225 F and line two baking sheets.
Arrange apple slices in a single layer without overlapping.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and sugar if using.
Bake 2 hours, flipping halfway, until dry and crisp.
Cool completely before storing in an airtight container.

recipes.title: Spinach and Cheese Stuffed Mushrooms
recipes.ingredients:
20 white mushrooms, stems removed
1 cup chopped spinach, wilted and drained
4 oz cream cheese, softened
1/4 cup grated parmesan
1 clove garlic, minced
Salt and pepper
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Mix spinach, cream cheese, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Fill each mushroom cap generously with the mixture.
Arrange on a baking sheet and bake 18-20 minutes until mushrooms are tender and tops are golden.
Serve warm.

recipes.title: Homemade Guacamole with Tortilla Chips
recipes.ingredients:
3 avocados
1/2 red onion, finely diced
1 tomato, diced
2 tbsp lime juice
1/4 cup chopped cilantro
Salt to taste
Tortilla chips for serving
recipes.instructions:
Mash avocados in a bowl to desired consistency.
Stir in onion, tomato, lime juice, and cilantro.
Season with salt to taste.
Serve immediately with tortilla chips.

recipes.title: Cheddar Cheese Crackers
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups shredded sharp cheddar
1 cup flour
6 tbsp cold butter, cubed
1/2 tsp salt
2-3 tbsp cold water
recipes.instructions:
Pulse cheddar, flour, butter, and salt in a food processor until crumbly.
Add water a little at a time until dough comes together.
Roll dough thin between two sheets of parchment.
Cut into small squares and transfer to a baking sheet.
Bake at 350 F for 12-15 minutes until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Yogurt Ranch Vegetable Dip
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups plain Greek yogurt
2 tbsp mayonnaise
1 tbsp dried dill
1 tsp garlic powder
1 tsp onion powder
Salt and pepper
Carrot, celery, and cucumber sticks
recipes.instructions:
Whisk yogurt, mayonnaise, dill, garlic powder, and onion powder together.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Chill 15 minutes to let flavors meld.
Serve with carrot, celery, and cucumber sticks.

recipes.title: Baked Parmesan Zucchini Sticks
recipes.ingredients:
2 zucchini, cut into sticks
1/2 cup flour
2 eggs, beaten
1 cup breadcrumbs
1/2 cup grated parmesan
1 tsp Italian seasoning
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F and line a baking sheet.
Mix breadcrumbs, parmesan, and Italian seasoning.
Dredge zucchini sticks in flour, then egg, then the breadcrumb mixture.
Arrange on the baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake 18-20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crisp.

recipes.title: Honey Roasted Mixed Nuts
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups mixed nuts (almonds, cashews, walnuts)
2 tbsp honey
1 tbsp butter, melted
1/2 tsp cinnamon
Pinch of salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 F.
Toss nuts with honey, melted butter, cinnamon, and salt.
Spread on a lined baking sheet in a single layer.
Bake 12-15 minutes, stirring halfway, until golden and fragrant.
Cool completely so the coating hardens before serving.

recipes.title: Pretzel Bites with Cheese Dip
recipes.ingredients:
1 lb pizza dough
1/4 cup baking soda
8 cups water
1 egg, beaten
Coarse salt
1 1/2 cups shredded cheddar for dip
1/2 cup milk
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Divide dough into small pieces and roll into balls.
Bring water and baking soda to a boil; boil each dough ball 20 seconds, then drain.
Arrange on a baking sheet, brush with egg, and sprinkle with salt.
Bake 12-15 minutes until deep golden brown.
Melt cheddar with milk over low heat for the dip and serve alongside.

recipes.title: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
2 1/4 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp salt
1 cup softened butter
3/4 cup sugar
3/4 cup brown sugar
2 eggs
2 tsp vanilla extract
2 cups chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Whisk flour, baking soda, and salt together.
Cream butter with both sugars until fluffy, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Gradually mix in the dry ingredients, then fold in chocolate chips.
Drop rounded spoonfuls onto baking sheets.
Bake 9-11 minutes until edges are golden; cool on the sheet briefly before transferring.

recipes.title: Vanilla Cupcakes with Buttercream
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 cup softened butter
1 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/2 cup milk
1 cup butter for frosting
3 cups powdered sugar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and line a muffin tin.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cream butter and sugar until fluffy, beat in eggs and vanilla, then alternate adding dry ingredients and milk.
Divide batter among cups and bake 18-20 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then beat butter and powdered sugar together for frosting and pipe onto cupcakes.

recipes.title: Fudgy Brownies
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup melted butter
1 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
1/3 cup cocoa powder
1/2 cup flour
1/4 tsp salt
1/2 cup chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and line an 8x8 pan.
Whisk melted butter and sugar, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Stir in cocoa powder, flour, and salt until just combined.
Fold in chocolate chips.
Pour into the pan and bake 25-30 minutes until a toothpick has a few moist crumbs.
Cool completely before slicing.

recipes.title: No-Bake Cheesecake Cups
recipes.ingredients:
16 oz cream cheese, softened
1/2 cup sugar
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup whipped cream
1 cup crushed graham crackers
1 1/2 cups mixed berries
recipes.instructions:
Beat cream cheese, sugar, and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in whipped cream gently.
Layer crushed graham crackers and cream cheese mixture in small cups or jars.
Top with mixed berries.
Chill at least 1 hour before serving.

recipes.title: Apple Crisp
recipes.ingredients:
5 apples, peeled and sliced
2 tbsp sugar
1 tsp cinnamon
1 cup rolled oats
1/2 cup flour
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup cold butter, cubed
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Toss apples with sugar and cinnamon and spread in a baking dish.
Mix oats, flour, and brown sugar, then cut in butter until crumbly.
Sprinkle topping evenly over the apples.
Bake 35-40 minutes until apples are tender and topping is golden.
Serve warm, with ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: Classic Vanilla Pudding
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups milk
1/3 cup sugar
3 tbsp cornstarch
Pinch of salt
2 egg yolks
1 tbsp butter
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Whisk sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a saucepan.
Gradually whisk in milk and egg yolks until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thickened and bubbling, about 6-8 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla.
Pour into cups and chill before serving.

recipes.title: Strawberry Shortcake
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
1/4 cup sugar
1 tbsp baking powder
1/2 tsp salt
6 tbsp cold butter, cubed
3/4 cup cream
2 cups sliced strawberries
2 tbsp sugar for strawberries
1 cup whipped cream
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt, then cut in butter until crumbly.
Stir in cream just until a dough forms.
Pat dough into a circle, cut into wedges, and bake 12-15 minutes until golden.
Toss strawberries with sugar and let sit 10 minutes to release juices.
Split biscuits, layer with strawberries and whipped cream, and serve.

recipes.title: Chocolate Pudding Cups
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups milk
1/3 cup sugar
3 tbsp cornstarch
3 tbsp cocoa powder
Pinch of salt
2 egg yolks
1 tbsp butter
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Whisk sugar, cornstarch, cocoa powder, and salt in a saucepan.
Gradually whisk in milk and egg yolks until smooth.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thickened, about 6-8 minutes.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla.
Pour into cups and chill at least 2 hours before serving.

recipes.title: Lemon Bars
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1/2 cup powdered sugar
1/2 cup cold butter, cubed
4 eggs
1 1/2 cups sugar
1/2 cup lemon juice
2 tbsp flour for filling
Powdered sugar for dusting
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F.
Pulse 1 1/2 cups flour, powdered sugar, and butter until crumbly, then press into a baking dish.
Bake crust 15 minutes until lightly golden.
Whisk eggs, sugar, lemon juice, and 2 tbsp flour, then pour over the hot crust.
Bake 25-30 more minutes until set.
Cool completely, dust with powdered sugar, and cut into bars.

recipes.title: Peanut Butter Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 cup peanut butter
1 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F.
Mix peanut butter, sugar, egg, baking soda, and vanilla until smooth.
Roll into balls and place on a baking sheet, pressing a crosshatch pattern with a fork.
Bake 10-12 minutes until set.
Cool on the sheet a few minutes before transferring to a rack.

recipes.title: Banana Cream Pie
recipes.ingredients:
1 pre-baked pie crust
2 cups milk
1/2 cup sugar
1/4 cup cornstarch
Pinch of salt
3 egg yolks
2 tbsp butter
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 bananas, sliced
1 cup whipped cream
recipes.instructions:
Whisk sugar, cornstarch, and salt in a saucepan, then whisk in milk and egg yolks.
Cook over medium heat, whisking constantly, until thickened.
Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla.
Layer banana slices in the pie crust, pour custard over top, and smooth.
Chill at least 3 hours, then top with whipped cream before serving.

recipes.title: Rice Krispie Treats
recipes.ingredients:
3 tbsp butter
10 oz marshmallows
6 cups crisp rice cereal
recipes.instructions:
Melt butter in a large pot over low heat.
Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted and smooth.
Remove from heat and stir in cereal until evenly coated.
Press mixture into a greased 9x13 pan.
Cool before cutting into squares.

recipes.title: Carrot Cake
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
2 tsp baking powder
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup oil
1 cup sugar
1/2 cup brown sugar
3 eggs
3 cups grated carrots
8 oz cream cheese for frosting
3 cups powdered sugar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and grease two round cake pans.
Whisk flour, baking powder, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Whisk oil, both sugars, and eggs, then combine with dry ingredients and fold in carrots.
Divide batter between pans and bake 30-35 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then beat cream cheese and powdered sugar for frosting and spread between and over layers.

recipes.title: Chocolate Mug Cake
recipes.ingredients:
4 tbsp flour
4 tbsp sugar
2 tbsp cocoa powder
1/4 tsp baking powder
Pinch of salt
3 tbsp milk
2 tbsp oil
1/4 tsp vanilla extract
recipes.instructions:
Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt in a large mug.
Stir in milk, oil, and vanilla until smooth.
Microwave on high 90 seconds to 2 minutes until set but still moist looking.
Let cool 1 minute before eating.
Top with a scoop of ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: Blueberry Cobbler
recipes.ingredients:
4 cups blueberries
1/2 cup sugar
1 tbsp lemon juice
1 cup flour
1/2 cup sugar for topping
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1/2 cup milk
4 tbsp melted butter
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Toss blueberries with sugar and lemon juice and spread in a baking dish.
Whisk flour, sugar, and baking powder, then stir in milk and melted butter until just combined.
Dollop the batter over the blueberries.
Bake 30-35 minutes until topping is golden and fruit is bubbling.
Serve warm, with ice cream if desired.

recipes.title: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
1 1/2 cups flour
1 tsp baking soda
1 tsp cinnamon
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup softened butter
1 cup brown sugar
1/2 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 tsp vanilla extract
3 cups rolled oats
1 cup raisins
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F.
Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Cream butter and both sugars, then beat in eggs and vanilla.
Mix in the dry ingredients, then fold in oats and raisins.
Drop spoonfuls onto baking sheets and bake 10-12 minutes until golden.
Cool on the sheet briefly before transferring.

recipes.title: Chocolate Layer Cake
recipes.ingredients:
2 cups flour
2 cups sugar
3/4 cup cocoa powder
1 1/2 tsp baking powder
1 1/2 tsp baking soda
1 tsp salt
2 eggs
1 cup milk
1/2 cup oil
1 cup hot water
2 cups chocolate frosting
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and grease two round cake pans.
Whisk flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
Add eggs, milk, and oil; beat until smooth, then stir in hot water (batter will be thin).
Divide between pans and bake 28-32 minutes until a toothpick comes out clean.
Cool completely, then frost between and over layers with chocolate frosting.

recipes.title: Snickerdoodle Cookies
recipes.ingredients:
2 3/4 cups flour
2 tsp cream of tartar
1 tsp baking soda
1/2 tsp salt
1 cup softened butter
1 1/2 cups sugar
2 eggs
3 tbsp sugar
2 tsp cinnamon for rolling
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 375 F.
Whisk flour, cream of tartar, baking soda, and salt.
Cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs.
Mix in the dry ingredients until a dough forms.
Roll dough into balls and coat in the cinnamon-sugar mixture.
Bake 8-10 minutes until edges are set; cool before serving.

recipes.title: Mixed Berry Galette
recipes.ingredients:
1 pie crust, store-bought or homemade
2 cups mixed berries
1/3 cup sugar
1 tbsp cornstarch
1 tsp lemon juice
1 egg, beaten for wash
1 tbsp coarse sugar
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 400 F.
Roll out pie crust on a lined baking sheet.
Toss berries with sugar, cornstarch, and lemon juice, then mound in the center of the crust, leaving a border.
Fold the edges up over the fruit, pleating as you go.
Brush crust with egg wash and sprinkle with coarse sugar.
Bake 30-35 minutes until crust is golden and filling bubbles.

recipes.title: Butterscotch Blondies
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup melted butter
1 cup brown sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 cup flour
1/4 tsp baking powder
Pinch of salt
1/2 cup butterscotch chips
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F and line an 8x8 pan.
Whisk melted butter and brown sugar, then beat in egg and vanilla.
Stir in flour, baking powder, and salt until just combined.
Fold in butterscotch chips.
Spread in the pan and bake 25-28 minutes until edges are golden and center is just set.
Cool before slicing.

recipes.title: Vanilla Ice Cream Sandwiches
recipes.ingredients:
16 chocolate chip cookies, store-bought or homemade
1 quart vanilla ice cream, slightly softened
Mini chocolate chips or sprinkles for rolling
recipes.instructions:
Lay half the cookies flat side up.
Scoop softened ice cream onto each cookie and top with a second cookie, pressing gently to spread the filling to the edges.
Roll the exposed ice cream edge in mini chocolate chips or sprinkles.
Wrap each sandwich individually and freeze at least 2 hours until firm.
Serve straight from the freezer.

recipes.title: Pumpkin Pie
recipes.ingredients:
1 pie crust, unbaked
1 can (15 oz) pumpkin puree
3/4 cup sugar
2 eggs
1 cup evaporated milk
2 tsp pumpkin pie spice
1/2 tsp salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 425 F.
Whisk pumpkin puree, sugar, eggs, evaporated milk, pumpkin pie spice, and salt until smooth.
Pour into the unbaked pie crust.
Bake 15 minutes, then reduce oven temperature to 350 F and bake 40 more minutes until the center is just set.
Cool completely before slicing, and chill leftovers.

recipes.title: Chocolate Chip Skillet Cookie
recipes.ingredients:
1/2 cup softened butter
1/2 cup brown sugar
1/4 cup sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
1 1/3 cups flour
1/2 tsp baking soda
1/4 tsp salt
1 cup chocolate chips
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 350 F.
Cream butter and both sugars, then beat in egg and vanilla.
Mix in flour, baking soda, and salt, then fold in chocolate chips.
Press dough into a greased oven-safe skillet.
Bake 20-25 minutes until edges are golden and center is just set.
Serve warm, ideally with ice cream.

recipes.title: Coconut Macaroons
recipes.ingredients:
3 cups shredded coconut
2/3 cup sweetened condensed milk
1 tsp vanilla extract
2 egg whites
Pinch of salt
recipes.instructions:
Preheat oven to 325 F and line a baking sheet.
Mix shredded coconut, condensed milk, and vanilla.
Beat egg whites with a pinch of salt to stiff peaks, then fold into the coconut mixture.
Drop spoonfuls onto the baking sheet, shaping into mounds.
Bake 15-18 minutes until edges are golden. Cool before removing.
